questions.q: A command says 'Missing script: m1'. What's the most likely cause?
options: You're not in the project folder (the one containing package.json)
You need to restart your computer
questions.why: npm looks for scripts in the package.json of the current folder. Run pwd, then cd into the project.

questions.q: How do you stop a program running in the terminal?
questions.why: Ctrl + C stops the running program. You'll also use it to crash services on purpose.

options: Do this, and wait until it's finished before moving to the next line
questions.why: await waits for something slow, like a call to another system, to finish before continuing.

questions.q: If `await bank.charge(...)` throws an error and nothing catches it, does the next line run?
questions.why: An uncaught error stops the function at that line.
